name: local-fill-form
description: Fill the local reflex test form, upload a file, submit, and verify echoed values.
when_to_use: Practice reflex on localhost test page only.

phases.name: fill
phases.verify_script: const vals = await h.eval('({n:document.querySelector("#name").value,e:document.querySelector("#email").value,m:document.querySelector("#message").value})'); const ok = vals.n===ARGS.name && vals.e===ARGS.email && vals.m===ARGS.message; return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'values mismatch: '+JSON.stringify(vals)};

phases.name: upload
phases.verify_script: const n = await h.eval('document.querySelector("#file").files.length'); return {ok: n>=1, why: 'file count='+n};

phases.name: submit
phases.verify_script: const shown = await h.eval('document.querySelector("#result")?.classList.contains("show")'); return {ok: !!shown, why: shown ? '' : 'result not shown'};

phases.name: verify-echo
phases.verify_script: const out = await h.eval('({n:document.querySelector("#out-name").textContent,e:document.querySelector("#out-email").textContent,m:document.querySelector("#out-message").textContent,f:document.querySelector("#out-file").textContent})'); const want = ARGS.file[0].split('/').pop(); const ok = out.n===ARGS.name && out.e===ARGS.email && out.m===ARGS.message && out.f===want; return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'echo mismatch: '+JSON.stringify(out)+' wantFile='+want};
